comment: The MPFB comparison's bodies (--visual people=mpfb). Five MakeHuman exports staged as rigged/mpfb_<id>/mpfb_<id>_rigged.glb; each person keeps the sex, stature variation and clip set its own binding gives it, and only the body changes. height_m is the exported file's measured overall height, used to bring every body to the stature its binding already had so the comparison is of fidelity, not of size. A body must state its sex: the variant armour is a male build (it carries mhair02, and its 2.423 m body is the big male morph), and a body that served both sexes made the two players land on the same model, so --autostart-body could not change the player's body at all.
